units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11:1">Cant. R. to I, 11</cite> <he>שחיפה בין נ׳ לנ׳</he> he put gold on between one board and the other; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:1:13">Y. Shek. VI, 49ᵈ</cite> bot. Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵇ bot.—Pl. <he>נְסָרִים</he>, <he>נְסָרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:6">B. Bath. IV, 6</cite> <he>הנ׳</he> the boards in the bath house.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 67b:7">Ib. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>בית הנ׳</he> the room in which the boards are stored.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 67b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מכר את נ׳</he> sold (with the press) the boards, v. <cite ref="J00539"><he>יְצִירִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3:7">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵃ</cite> top <he>להיות מגלין את הנ׳</he> to remove the boards (which covered the bathing tank). Bab.
